content:
ravi: Heads-up: after the client libs update we9re seeing a small spike in requests with quota="unknown". Traces show model id correct but quota mapping failed for some hops.

taylor: Any correlation with header change we shipped? (the new Route header earlier this month)

ravi: Yesmdash; new SDKs send `X-Rd-Route` while a few proxies still only preserve `X-Route-Hint`. Mapping code had a codepath that only checked the old header.

mina: Can quota service do a tolerant lookup ordering? Try new header then old then any route meta? Should be low-risk.

carl: We must avoid double attribution if both headers present. Add a deterministic prefer-order and emit a counter `quota.header.resolve` with value set to which header was used.

ravi: Agreed. I prototyped a tiny change: extractHeader(headers, ["x-rd-route","x-route-hint","route-meta"]) where keys are lowercased first. Also add `dry_run` flag that writes resolved_key into `test_attrib` column.

taylor: From SDK side we can ship a light compat shim that writes both headers for 72h and emits an analytics event on first-time compatibility mode. Prefer server fallback + SDK shim to accelerate fixes.

ops-bot: deploy-started: quota-mapper/fallback-lookup -> canary eu-west-1 (ci job 10982)

mina: Also, casing normalization: some infra lowercases headers; ensure our lookup lowercases keys and test across nginx/elb/gcp-edge. Add integration matrix.

carl: Backfill plan: run recompute over parquet logs for the last 36-72h once metric shows impacted tenant list. Use dry-run to validate results and then swap.

ravi: Action items: (1) land tolerant lookup + metric + dry_run (ravi) (2) cut py/ts compat shim that emits both headers and first-run event (taylor) (3) ops run canary and validate `quota.header.resolve` labels (ops) (4) mina schedule backfill dry-run & then recompute (mina) (5) carl draft billing note and console tooltip update for transient recompute (carl).

pm-billing: will prepare notice and hold retro invoices until we confirm recompute scope.

ravi: will post canary metrics here in ~20m. If header_mismatch > 1% we stop and roll back. Thanks everyone.
